content: HomuHomu833/android-ndk-custom (MIT, 198 stars, active Oct 2026) publishes android-ndk-r27c-aarch64-linux-gnu.tar.xz and -musl under release tag r27 (assets re-uploaded periodically; sha256 digest 9c6214a6... on 2026-10-03). Layout uses toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-arm64 and shader-tools/linux-arm64/glslc, not linux-x86_64. Alternatives: SnowNF/ndk-aarch64-linux (r29 only), kaspersigi/android-ndk-r27d-linux-aarch64 (1 star). Google ships no linux-arm64 NDK host.
